Tooltip_KBWCB_FencePost: Fence post for finishing fence ends.
Tooltip_KBWCB_StorageReinforced: Reinforced metal storage with a large capacity.
Tooltip_KBWCB_CounterTop: New top for a counter. Build it on a counter; it fits the counter's shape, and a sink or anything else on the counter stays on top. Right-click the counter to remove it.
Tooltip_KBWCB_Speaker: Speaker cabinet for decoration. It does not play sound.
Tooltip_KBWCB_NeonSign: Wall-mounted neon sign. Lights up when switched on, with power.
Tooltip_KBWCB_WallShelfDecor: Small decorative shelf that hangs on a wall. It does not hold items.
Tooltip_KBWCB_Floor: Floor covering. Lay it on a square with a floor.
